515)༄/sman sgom gyi dris lan/gnyis chos zung 'jug gi ngo sprod zhal gdams bzhugs so/ /516)sman sgom rig pa 'dzin pa mchog gis da lam gyi phyag bri

tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ sman sgom gyi dris lan/ gnyis chos zung 'jug gi ngo sprod zhal gdams bzhugs so// 516) sman sgom rig pa 'dzin pa mchog gis da lam gyi phyag bris yig chung gnang ba'i zhib char/ gsal ba zhes bya ba gang yin pa'i dngos don kha gsal dgos gsungs pa la brjod par bya ste/ thog mar 'gro ba sems can thams cad 'khrul pa shar te 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu rkyen yang kun gzhi las gsal cha'i snang ba shar ba la rang mdangs yin par ma shes par yul du bzung zhing*/ rang gzhan tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dbang gis 'khrul pa yin tshul sogs 517)kyi zhib cha rnams/ sngar phyag rdzogs zin bris gnyis kyi 'gor yod pa ltar yin pa dang*/ da lta lam nyams len gyi dus su yang*/ sems nyid ngo bo stong pa ngos bzung bral ba'i rang mdangs gsal ba 'gag med kyi cha las phyi nang gi 'char sgo mtha' dag snang ba 'di yin te/ phyi rol gyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg sogs tshogs drug gi yul du gyur pa thams cad gsal ba'i char ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med mod/ nang gi mig rna ba sna lce lus yid kyi 'gyur tshor 518)chags sdang thams cad kyang gsal bar ma gyur pa ci yang med la/ de ltar phyi nang gi dngos po mtha' dag ma lus pa rang sems kyi gsal cha'i 'char sgo kho na yin pa 'di la gsal ba zer/ 'di med na 'khor bar 'khyams 'khrul sogs dang*/ thugs rje nyams len byed rgyu byed mkhan byas 'bras thams cad mi 'byung bar/ stong pa phyang chad dang*/ chad pa'i mthar lhung ba zhig las mi 'byung tshe/ de'i phyir theg pa gong 'og gi nyams len kun dang*/ khyad par sgom phyogs kyi skabs 'dir gsal cha lam du 'khyer tshul rnams bshad pa yin la/ lhag par ding sang gi sgom chen la la zhig bla ma mtshan ldan dang gdams ngag zol med kyis ma zin pa'i skyon dbang gis/ sems kyi gsal cha'i 'char sgo thams cad sgom du mi 'dod par nan gyis bkag nas/ mi rtog pa zhig kho na dgos par 'dod mkhan mang du gda' bas/

de 519)ltar byas na zhi gnas 'gog par 'gyur tshe/ phyag rdzogs kyi sgom du gtan du mi 'gro la byang chub kyi lam du'ang mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ mthar thug 'bras bu mngon 'gyur gyi dus na'ang mkhyen brtse mdzad phrin thugs rje sogs thams cad kyang gsal ba 'di'i mthu 'bras yin pas/ da lta lam gyi dus su 'di bkag na mthar 'bras bu'i dus mkhyen brtse sogs ga nas 'ong*/ de'i phyir na/ nyams len gyi rtsa ba gsal ba lam 'khyer byed pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin pa dang*/ lam du 'khyer tshul gang zhe na/ rnam rtog dang tshogs drug gang snang ci shar thams cad la a 'thas rjes 'breng yang mi bya/ dgag kyang mi dgag gnyen po dang dmigs pa'i kha bsgyur sogs gzhan gang yang mi bya bar/ rang rig kho nas zin tsam rang sar glod/ gang dgar bskyur/ gar 'gror btang*/ 520)ji ltar 'char yang tha mal shes pa so ma 'di ka las ma 'das tshe/ bzang ngan gyi zhen 'dzin dgag sgrub mi bya ba 'di nyid kho nas chog pa la rang rig rang gsal gyi nyams len zer ba lags shing*/ ༈ 'gag don la/ da lta'i rnam rtog 'gyu dran 'di ka la gsal ba zer ba yin/ 'di nyid rang la rang gis rig tsam dran tsam tshor tsam byed mkhan de la dran pa yang zer/ rang rig kyang zer/ mnyam bzhag kyang zer/ lhag mthong yang zer ba ste/ chos lugs thams cad kyi dgongs pa mthun par sgom nyams su len rgyu 'di rang gis chog pa lags shing*/ 'di las lhag pa'i sgom gnas cha'am/ bde gsal mi rtog sogs ci lta bu zhig bsgrub kyang bcos ma kho na yin tshe ma bcos tha mal shes pa bzo med du mi 'gro zhing sgom skyon med du mi 'gyur bas/ des na gnas 'di gcig pu la 521)nges 'drongs thag chod cig dgos pa lags pas de ltar dgongs 'tshal/ ༈ gnyis chos zung 'jug gi rnam grangs mang po de dag gi don gang yin gsungs pa la/ ༈ gsal stong dbyer med ces pa'i gsal ba ni gong du brjod pa de ka yin la/

stong pa ni/ 'khor 'das kyi 'char sgo cir snang gi gsal cha de thams cad kyi ngo bo ni rang sems kho na las ma 'das la/ sems kho rang kha dog dbyibs mtshan du ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid dang*/ de gnyis kyang don la tha mi dad par/ stong pa'i rang mdangs gsal ba gsal ba'i ngo bo stong pa yin pa de la gsal stong dbyer med ces bya ba'o/ ༈ yang snang stong ni/ kha dog dbyibs kyi snang tshul gang dang gang ltar 'char ba mtha' dag la zhes bya la/ de dag ji ltar snang yang sems kyi mdangs las gzhan pa'i dngos po bden 522)par grub pa gtan nas ma yin pa'i phyir ngo bo stong pa/ de gnyis tha dad med pa ni gong ma ltar ro/ ༈ yang*/ mtshon byed dpe'i bla ma dngos su snang ba ni snang cha'am gsal cha'i bye brag yin la/ des ngo sprad nas rang sems rang ngo rig pa ni mtshon bya don gyi bla ma de gnyis dbyer med tshul ni gong ltar ro/ ༈ snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad ni rang sems kyi rol rtsal/ de dag gi rang bzhin ni stong pa stong pa'i yin tshul rig cing rtogs pa ni rig stong dbyer med/ ༈ tshor ba bde ba'i rigs gang shar thams cad ni sdug bsngal gyi zug ngu med pas na bde ba zhes bya la bde bar shar mkhan nam/ tshor mkhan ni sems nyid kho rang*/ bde ba de nyid dngos po bden grub med par sems kyi gsal cha'i bye brag las gzhan pa'i dngos po gang yang min phyir bde stong dbyer med ces bya'o/ ༈ gzhan yang*/ lha dang 423)dkyil 'khor sngags dang 'od zer spro bsdu sogs mtha' dag kyang don dam par ni sgom mkhan sgom rgyu bsgom pa sogs thams cad sems las gzhan med la/ sems kyi ngo bo stong pa rdzogs rim/ gsal cha lhar snang ba skyed rim/ de gnyis sems gcig pur tshang phyir skyed rdzogs dbyer med yin te/ 'di skabs kyi go don zhib cha ni sngar nas yang yang gsung gleng byed res yod tshe thugs la los bzhugs mod kyi/

ding sang gi skyed rim pa phal mo che rnams ni kun brtags blos byas kyi skyed rim ma gtogs/ skyed rdzogs dbyer med la blo khel mkhan cher ma mthong tshe/ slad du ngos mjal byung na 'di don gyi gsung gleng zhib tu yong las che lags/ yang*/ sku dang ye shes ni/ dngos por snang ba'i gsal cha mtha' dag ni sku yi rang bzhin du ye nas lhun gyis grub la/ de dag gi rang bzhin stong gsal 524)ni gdod ma'i ye shes las ma 'das so/ 'di la'ang rgyas bshad byas na ni tshig tshogs che bas ma bris la/ 'gag ni gsal stong dbyer med la 'dus so/ ༈ dbyings rig dbyer med ni/ stong cha la dbyings kyang zer/ yum yang zer/ gsang ba'i bha ga yang zer/ shes rabs kyang zer/ chos dbyings yang zer la/ gsal rig gi cha la rig pa yang zer/ yab kyang zer/ rdo rje dang*/ thabs dang*/ ye shes la sogs ming gi rnam grangs du mar btags mod kyang*/ don la 'di gnyis kyang gong du brjod pa ltar sems nyid gsal stong gnyis las gzhan min cing*/ dbyer med tshul ni sngar bzhin no/ ༈ thabs shes dbyer med ni 'di kas go la 'di skabs/ thabs lam gyi gdams gzhung rnams las/ rtsa thams cad dpa' mo yum gyi rang bzhin/ rlung thams cad dpa' bo yab kyi rang bzhin dang*/ thig le dkar cha 525)thams cad yab dang dmar cha thams cad yum du gsungs pa dang*/ bde ba yab dang stong pa yum/ de bzhin du rtsa ro rkyang dang rlung pho rlung mo rlung gnyis thabs shes so sor gsungs tshul sogs/ spros bcas nyams len gyi rigs rnams nas rgya cher gsungs te/ dper na rdor dril gnyis kyi brda don rnam bshad gcig pu la yang bsam gyis mi khyab mod kyi/ 'gag don gyi rang sems gsal stong la ma 'dus pa zhig ga la mchis/ ༈ stong nyid dang snying rje ni/ sems kyi ngo bo spros bral stong nyid gong du brjod pa bzhin las/ gdangs 'gags med kyi 'char tshul tsam du/ ma rtogs pa'i 'gro la snying rje bcos min rang shugs su 'char ba dang*/

shar yang shar mkhan dang 'char rgyu shar pa'i yul sogs mtha' dag rang rig gcig pu nyid yin tshul rtogs pa ni stong nyid snying rje 526)zung 'jug yin te/ las byang rnams nas kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin de yang 'di yin pa dang*/ chos spyi khyab ltar na 'di la yang*/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje sogs kyi rgyas bshad mang mod kyang*/ skabs 'dir ni bdag dang sems can dang snying rje nyid dang gsum ga rang sems gcig pur thag chod pa kho nas chog go/ ༈ bdag gzhan dbyer med kyang 'di ka yin te/ bdag dang gzhan du snang ba thams cad ni 'khrul rtog gi bag chags yin phyir/ sems nyid gsal stong spros bral gyi rang ngo la bdag gzhan gyi dngos po ma grub la/ bdag gzhan du snang zhing mthong ba 'di dag ni rmi lam gyi snang ba ltar/ med pa la yod par sgro btags pa'i bag chags kyi rang gzugs yin no/ ༈ phyi nang gnyis kyang de bzhin te/ sems kyis bcos shing btags pa'i bag chags 527)'khrul gzugs 'ba' shig yin no/ ༈ 'khor 'das gnyis ni rnam bshad rgyas par byas na kha thag ring bas 'gag don la/ 'khrul ngor 'char zhing snang ba thams cad 'khor ba'i chos yin la/ 'khrul pa rang mtshang rig pa'i cha thams cad myang 'das kyi chos yin pa dang*/ don dam par ni 'khrul ma 'khrul du dbye ba nyid kyang ngos bzung gi mtshan ma dang bral phyir 'khor 'das kyang sems su thag chod dgos la/ de ltar chod na/ rgyu 'bras/ dge sdig ngan song dang thar lam/ sems can dang sangs rgyas chos dang chos min sogs spang blang gi mtshan ma mtha' dag rang sar grol/ de grol tshe/ yar sangs rgyas rgyu'am/ mar 'khor bar 'khyams rgyu'i gzhi rtsa zad pa de la grub pa thob zer ba'am/ 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa zhes zer ba lags mod/ ༈ 528)stong nyid rgyu 'bras dbyer med kyang 'dir 'dus mod kyi/ stong nyid kyi don tshul bzhin rtogs tshe gsal ba'i rol rtsal rgyu 'bras su 'char/

'char ba de'i rang ngo stong nyid du thag chod pa de la stong nyid rgyu 'bras dbyer med zer ba ste/ tshul 'di ma go bar/ rgyu 'bras mi bden/ thams cad stong pa yin zer pa'i nag po kha 'byams rnams dang ma 'dzol pa gal che bar snang ngo*/ ༈ nam mkha' rang sems dbyer med ni/ chos spyi ltar na phyi'i 'byung ba lnga dang nang gi khams lnga po sbyar ba ste/ de skabs su phyi'i 'byung ba nam mkha' dang nang du sems kyi khams gcig tshul bshad mod kyang*/ spros med kyi skabs 'dir ni/ 'byung ba nam mkha' tsam du ma zad snang srid 'khor 'das mtha' dag sems thog tu thag chod phyir gzhan brjod ma dgos so/ ༈ skyid sdug dbyer med ni gong ma rnams su ma 'dus rgyu med kyang*/ 529)bde sdug gam skyid sdug chags sdang*/ bzang ngan/ gtsang mi gtsang*/ zhim mngar/ tsha grang*/ legs nyes/ dgra gnyen/ lha 'dre/ phan gnod la sogs te/ 'di 'dra'i rigs mtha' dag kun/ sems nyid kyi gsal cha'i bye brag 'gag med kyi rtsal mdangs tsam du 'char yang*/ rang gi rang bzhin gang du yang grub pa med pas stong ba nyid las ma g.yos pa de la don dam bden pa zer/ rang bzhin med kyang 'char tshul sna tshogs zad med du shar/ mthong*/ tshor/ med bzhin du snang ba'i cho 'phrul rmi lam dang sgyu ma'i ltad mo lta bu 'di la kun rdzob bden pa zer ba ste/ 'di dag thams cad la so skye tha mal pa rnams kyis ni mi bden pa la bden par bzung*/ rang snang la gzhan du bzung*/ don dam ma yin pa la don dam du bzung ba la brten nas 'khor bar 'khrul 'byams khor yug tu gyur zhing*/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis 530)ni de dag gi gnad mtshang ji bzhin rig cing shes pa dang*/ shes thog tu dgag sgrub bral bar bzhag pa gcig pus 'khrul pa rang sar grol ba lags mod kyi/ de ltar 'jog thabs dang grol thabs ni theg pa kun gyi yang rtse rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang phyag rdzogs lta bu la ma brten na/

'og ma'i chos gzhan dag gis grol mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan dang gnad kyang de yin no/ ༈ yang*/ gshin po sogs sems can kun gyi sems dang rang sems bsre ba'i gnad gang yin gsungs pa ni/ spyir bde gshegs snying po 'gro kun yongs la khyab pa de yang*/ mi re re la dum bu re re bgos nas yod pa lta bu zhig ma yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs/ sems can gyi sems/ snang grags kun gyi rang tshul mtha' dag rgyar ma chad/ phyogs su ma lhung ye gdod ma na rang bzhin chos kyi skur kun la khyab/ lhun gyis grub/ phyogs 531)ris bral ba'i thig le nyag gcig yin kyang*/ rig ma rig dang rtogs ma rtogs/ 'khrul ma 'khrul kho nas khyad par du gyur la/ da lta lam nyams len gyis skabs su yang*/ gong ma rnams su yang yang bshad pa ltar/ bdag dang sems can zhes tha dad don la ma grub kyang*/ snad tshul tha dad du snang ba tsam yin pa'i tshul rtogs na/ sems can gyi sems dang rang gi sems slar bsre rgyu zhig ma grub ste/ ye nas 'dres 'dres pa yin la/ 'on kyang las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor dag gis sems kyi rtsal sbyong ngam/ 'gag med rol rtsal gyi sgyu 'phrul tsam du/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la byams snying rje sems skyed dang*/ snang grags lha sngags kyi zhing sbyor sogs dang*/ des mtshon te/ gtor ma gcod/ bsngo smon sogs byed pa yin mod kyi/ de dag gi skabs su/ dper na/ bla ma dran tsam la bla ma dang rang sems 'dres tshar ba yin te/ 532)bla mar snang ba de nyid rang sems kho rang yin pa'i phyir ro/ de bzhin du/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can zhes brjod pa tsam nas sems can kun gyi sems dang*/ rang gi sems 'dres tshar ba ste/ don la tha dad ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ gnad don 'di lta bu thams cad la 'gres shes dgos te/ lha la rab gnas/ mi la dbang bskur/ lha 'dre la gcod yul/ tshe 'das la gnas spar/

sems can spyi khyab la sems skyed dang bsngo smon sogs thams cad la gnad don 'di mi shes par gzhan phan ci dang ci lta bur byed par rloms kyang tshul mthun zhig nam yang mi 'ong ste/ 'di dag gi lung 'dren sogs shin tu mang mod kyang 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bkod la/ 'di dang mthun par rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i blo sbyong don bzhi ma sogs kyang dgongs don 'di ka lags shing*/ theg chen gyi chos thams cad la 'dis khyab pa lags/ ༈ lar yang theg chen dang gsang sngags kyi chos nyams su len par 533)byed pa la blo khog yangs dgos pa dang*/ khyad par phyag rdzogs dbu gsum sogs lta sgom gyi chos blo la shong ba la dbang po rab sogs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin pas/ theg dman blo chung la 'di dag gi gnad don bshad kyang rang gi skal ba dang ma mthun tshe blor mi shong*/ yid mi ches/ nges shes mi 'grongs/ de'i skyon gyis rgyud la mi khel bar lta spyod nyams len tshig don thams cad ya bral kho nar gyur pa ni ding sang shin tu mang bar mchis tshe/ 'khos med bdag 'dras 'gro don dang gzhan phan mi nus shing mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ ༈ gzhan/ nyid rang gi thod rgal gyi 'char tshul de rnams la ni bogs 'don sogs kyi zhib cha gzhan dgos par ma gyur tshe/ sngar las ma g.yos pa'i nyams len rgyun brtson mdzad pa dang*/ sku dang 534)zhing khams kyi snang ba ci dang ci ltar 'char yang*/ gtso bor blta bya'i yul dang lta byed kyi rig pa tha dad ma grub pa'i ngang nas/ zhen 'dzin rlom sems kyi 'khri ba med par gu yangs rang babs kyi klong nas nyams len gnang 'tshal zhing*/ ༈ mdor hril gyi dril ba'i snying por gang gi gnyis chos kyi rnam grangs de dag thams cad kyang rang rig blo 'das rjen pa'i thog tu ma 'dus rgyu ni spu tsam yang med pas 'di ka la bzo med lhug par 'jog pa kho nas chog gi dbye ba dang ming tshig gi rnam grangs mtha' dag ni brjod kyis kyang mi lang la/

brjod kyang dgos pa chung ba dang*/ rjod byed kyi tshig tshogs mang pos brjod bya don gyi rang zhal sgrib byed 'ba' zhig las mi 'byung bas/ dpe la blta ba'am/ go ba 'tshol ba dang*/ mched grogs la chos gtam sogs gang dang gang byas rung sems la mi phan pa'i khar/ slar dogs pa spel 535)ba las ma mchis tshe/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad la brtag dpyad dam/ go bsdur ram/ 'chad rtsod sogs kyi spros pas mi g.yeng bar/ da lta'i tha mal shes pa rang 'gros rang babs kho na bskyangs/ mnyam rjes thun mtshams bzhag len sogs las dang po pa'i dus kyi nyams len spros bcas rnams la a 'thas kyi zhen 'dzin dang*/ nyams rtogs 'phel bskyed/ lam rtags gong 'phel sogs 'ong du re ba'i 'dod blo thams cad lings kyi bskyur nas rig pa rjen pa gcig pu la dam 'jus su bya zhing*/ sangs rgyas na rgyas la ma rgyas na ma rgyas/ 'khor bar 'khyams na 'khyams la ma 'khyams na ma 'khyams/ bdud dang bar chad sogs yod na yod med na med/ ci dga' ba gyis/ gang yong na shog gar 'gro na'ang song snyam pas/ bsnyems thag rbad kyi chod/ lings kyi bskyur/ cam gyi 'jog pa zhig 536)kho nas sku tshe 'khyol bar mdzod dang*/ gegs sel bogs 'don ngo sprod gdams ngag yod do cog gcig tu bsdus kyang 'di las zab pa bstan rgyu med pas/ des na tshe 'di'i snang ba thibs kyi ma 'gag gi bar la gnad don 'di dang mi 'bral ba mdzad par zhu/

zhes pa 'di ni/ sman pa sgom chen tshul khrims bzang pos dri yig gi lan du/ lho bde gshegs tshe ring phug pa'i yang dben nas bris te bsrings pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ maṅga lam bha wantu// chos sgo brgyad khrir gsungs kyang dgos ched sems 'dul thabs// tshig tshogs grangs med brjod byang gnad don sgom la rag /mi tshe chos la bskyal yang rang rgyud thul ma thul// rkyen ngan cung zad byung tshe gsal rtags mngon sum ston// kha bshad chu yi lbu bas byang chub lam mi rnyed// gnad don snying po'i mthar thug rang sems gnas lugs don// ma bcos bzo med skyong la gegs dang gol sa med// rang rig gcig pu'i steng du blo thag rbad kyi chod// snying gtam gdams ngag yin no snying gi dkyil du 'chongs// dge'o//
